question: Which measured GLM-4.7-Flash bottleneck opportunities deserve the next dollar of experiment budget, and what evidence would falsify each one?
claim_scope: Opportunity ranking for the complete BF16 H100 SGLang control and public AWQ L40S vLLM candidate under the campaign fixed 8192-input/1024-output geometry and compact paired diagnostic through V28R1.
claim_non_scope: matched Fireworks or Baseten performance or economics

evidence_labels.measured: Produced by a campaign allocation or retained local artifact.
evidence_labels.derived: Arithmetic over measured values under an explicit formula.
evidence_labels.vendor_reported: Provider or tool-vendor statement in official documentation.
evidence_labels.prior_art_claim: Primary paper result limited to its own scope.
evidence_labels.inferred: Causal interpretation not isolated by the current experiment.

critical_trace_warning.scope: c1 mixed prefill and decode diagnostic under profiler
prohibited_interpretations: Amdahl coefficient for a 5% c8 prediction
proof that grouped MLA is the dominant production bottleneck
critical_trace_warning.reason: CUDA kernels can overlap, CUDA Graph replay complicates phase attribution, and summed component duration is not additive wall time.

source_catalog.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model

opportunities.title: Exact-shape grouped MLA decode autotune

observation.summary: Eight KV splits cut exact-shape grouped attention by 40.27% and summed c8 attention/MLA profiler work by 33.43%, but two same-session bracketed server effects were only +1.0476% and +1.0447%. The lineage is stopped below the 5% end-to-end gate.
observation.evidence_scope: AWQ BF16 activation, vLLM 0.15.0, L40S SM89; resource evidence from c1 trace and compile, c8 effect from fixed burst workload.
observation.limitations: The approximately 37.38% old trace value is summed c1 mixed-phase kernel duration only. V23R1 retained aggregate rather than raw interleaved timings. V24R2 validates c8 grid/resources but still does not establish non-overlapping phase wall time or an Amdahl coefficient.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: A different legal combination of head tile, sequence tile, warps, stages, and KV splits can reduce full grouped-attention component latency at GLM's absorbed MLA shape.
competing_explanations: The stock kernel is already near the best legal L40S point.
Profiler overhead inflates the apparent component share.
C8 serving is limited by MoE, GEMV, scheduling, or host launch work rather than MLA.
Hot-cache microbenchmarks overstate production gains.

candidate.intervention: Bounded standalone sweep over BLOCK_H, BLOCK_N, num_warps, num_stages, and NUM_KV_SPLITS using the source-pinned installed kernel.

uncertainty.level: high for end-to-end effect; medium for component opportunity
uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: Do not transfer component timing to c8 serving until a matched phase trace and full-server A/B exist.

prospective_effect.component_gate: A stable, correctness-passing material latency reduction with a lower confidence bound above zero; retain the campaign's >=10% screen only as a minimum component threshold.
prospective_effect.end_to_end_gate: Unknown until a matched c8 phase share is measured; require a conservative prediction of >=5% and then a repeated full-server result.

opportunities.falsifier: Observed: two matched bracketed c8 effects were about 1.05%, below the 5% end-to-end gate despite verified component work reduction.

next_measurement.workload_geometry: B1 and B8, absorbed query width 576, value width 512, 20 heads, page size 16, long-context sequence samples from 8193 through 9215.
next_measurement.quality_gate: Component numerical correctness against float32 oracle plus stock-error non-regression; full semantic and paired quality only after server promotion.
next_measurement.service_gate: Not applicable at component scope; full-server holdout retains exact c8 geometry, TTFT, TPOT, success, and cache gates.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: Typed result for every legal and illegal candidate, raw correctness and timing samples, environment/source hashes, telemetry, cost, manifest, and verified teardown.

information_value.expected_resolution: Cheaply determines whether the trace-selected kernel has any legal local headroom before paying checkpoint and server costs.
information_value.information_per_dollar: high; no checkpoint transfer is required

opportunities.claim_boundary: A faster component is not a serving or economic improvement until a matched repeated full-server A/B passes.

opportunities.title: CUDA-graph-aware c8 phase attribution

observation.summary: V24R2 now has a valid eight-request c8 8K-prefill/128-decode trace and validates grouped-MLA batch grids, but lacks a matched profiler-off control, prefill/mixed/steady-decode separation, attribution coverage, and non-overlapping critical-path intervals.
observation.evidence_scope: V21 c1 mixed trace plus V24R2 exact c8 PyTorch trace on the same AWQ L40S stack.
observation.limitations: V24R2 is c8 but still mixed prefill/decode, lacks observer perturbation measurement, phase coverage, dependency-union wall time, and hardware memory counters.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: A phase-scoped c8 timeline and bounded hardware-counter pass can distinguish attention, MoE, GEMV, scheduler, and launch critical paths.
competing_explanations: Profiler perturbation changes batching.
Node-level graph tracing adds excessive overhead.
No single kernel dominates wall time at c8.

candidate.intervention: Add NVTX prefill/decode ranges, CUDA Graph node tracing, and bounded Nsight Compute sections on finalist kernels.

uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: Do not use observed component shares without an unprofiled control and overhead measurement.

prospective_effect.component_gate: Not applicable; observer validation requires phase coverage and bounded overhead.
prospective_effect.end_to_end_gate: Unprofiled throughput regression from instrumentation must be measured and remain within a preregistered diagnostic tolerance.

opportunities.falsifier: The instrumentation cannot produce phase-scoped attribution with bounded overhead or cannot reconcile graph replay with kernel/resource evidence.

next_measurement.workload_geometry: Eight simultaneous 8192-input/128-output requests after warmup, plus an unprofiled matched control.
next_measurement.quality_gate: Exact semantic smoke before profiling; no quality claim from trace.
next_measurement.service_gate: Capture is diagnostic; record TTFT, TPOT, throughput, and profiler overhead.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: Raw nsys/ncu reports, exported summaries, commands, tool versions, hashes, overhead control, and scope labels.

information_value.expected_resolution: Prevents the campaign from optimizing a large summed-work component that is not on the c8 critical path.
information_value.information_per_dollar: high if performed in a retained server session

opportunities.claim_boundary: Profiler shares are diagnostic attribution, not performance improvements.

opportunities.title: MoE routing and GEMV decode opportunity

observation.summary: Matched c8 trace comparison shows dense GEMM/GEMV as the largest residual summed decode family after MLA work was reduced, while decode annotation span stayed flat. MoE expert work is present but the resource and dependency critical path remains unresolved.
observation.evidence_scope: V13 batch-one complete BF16 decode annotations; shares are summed kernel duration, not end-to-end c8 wall time.
observation.limitations: Different runtime, representation, GPU, and concurrency from the AWQ L40S candidate.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: Routing/alignment or small-batch GEMV may offer more c8 headroom than the first MLA tile.
competing_explanations: These families overlap or are hidden by CUDA Graph execution.
Marlin kernels are already tuned.
A component gain is diluted across 47 layers and serving overhead.

candidate.intervention: No code change yet; first obtain c8 phase-scoped family/resource evidence and rank exact operations.
candidate.stock_control: V21 AWQ L40S tuned serving point.
changed_variables: observer only for the next measurement

uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: Do not transfer V13 family shares to V21.

prospective_effect.component_gate: Require a named operation, exact shape, resource signature, and prospective >=5% c8 ceiling before implementation.

opportunities.falsifier: Matched c8 profiling shows no single modifiable MoE/GEMV operation with a conservative >=5% end-to-end ceiling.

next_measurement.quality_gate: Observer-only; retain current semantic and paired diagnostic state.
next_measurement.service_gate: Record observer overhead and preserve exact request geometry.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: Phase-scoped trace/counter report and ranked candidate table with removable fraction and risk.

information_value.expected_resolution: Determines whether the next custom lineage should target attention, routing, or GEMV.
information_value.information_per_dollar: high in a retained session; low as a fresh allocation

opportunities.claim_boundary: Architecture prior art and H100 family shares do not prove a GLM AWQ L40S bottleneck.

opportunities.title: Agent-prefix cache and scheduling control

observation.summary: V21 eliminated fixed-burst queueing but the campaign has not measured the frozen agent_prefix workload or a tuned cache-enabled incumbent.
observation.evidence_scope: Fixed repeated 8K synthetic completion workload with prefix caching deliberately disabled.
observation.limitations: The fixed workload cannot establish agent prefix-reuse benefit and would exaggerate reuse if caching were enabled indiscriminately.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: Tenant-safe exact prefix reuse and schedule policy can reduce redundant prefill work on an agent-prefix workload even though the fixed burst is no longer queue-bound.
competing_explanations: Real prefix identity is low.
Cache lookup and fragmentation offset saved compute.
Agent arrivals reduce batch efficiency.

candidate.intervention: Cache off/on and schedule-policy A/B on a content-addressed agent-prefix workload with tenant-safe reuse.
candidate.stock_control: Best supported stock vLLM settings with cache disabled.

uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: Do not transfer PagedAttention or SGLang paper gains to GLM.

prospective_effect.component_gate: Measured prefill-token and KV-byte savings under exact prefix identities.
prospective_effect.end_to_end_gate: >=5% SLO-goodput or cost gain at unchanged quality and availability.

opportunities.falsifier: A valid agent-prefix replay has negligible reusable-token share or cache-on fails to improve SLO-goodput by 5%.

next_measurement.workload_geometry: Frozen agent_prefix sessions with exact prompt identities, declared tenant boundaries, and a fixed arrival schedule.
next_measurement.quality_gate: Identical deterministic semantic outputs and paired quality policy.
next_measurement.service_gate: TTFT, TPOT, success, queueing, no truncation, and SLO-goodput.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: Raw replay schedule and outcomes, cache counters, stock/candidate repeats, cost, and cleanup.

information_value.expected_resolution: Tests a tuned general-stack mechanism that must be beaten before claiming model-specific differentiation.

opportunities.claim_boundary: Paper results are prior art only; no agent-serving claim exists until the exact GLM replay passes.

opportunities.title: Representation-runtime-hardware factorial bridge

observation.summary: The best measured whole-stack point is AWQ/vLLM/L40S at 355.772 output tok/s and derived $0.670/M versus BF16/SGLang/H100 at 305.045 tok/s and derived $3.528/M.
observation.evidence_scope: Matched fixed token geometry and SLO, paired diagnostic quality only; runtime, representation, and GPU differ.
observation.limitations: Both arms fail the absolute compact quality gate; provider and fully loaded costs are unmatched.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: Most economic benefit comes from public AWQ enabling a much cheaper GPU, while runtime and scheduler contribute smaller effects.
competing_explanations: vLLM is faster than SGLang for this checkpoint.
H100 and L40S pricing dominates representation.
Checkpoint implementation differences change work.

candidate.intervention: Bridge controls such as AWQ on H100 under vLLM and BF16 under the same runtime/hardware where feasible.
candidate.stock_control: V13 and V21 endpoints plus same-runtime bridge controls.
changed_variables: one of representation, runtime, or GPU per arm
unchanged_controls: server tuning within each declared comparison

uncertainty.level: high for causal attribution; low for the scoped endpoint arithmetic
uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: Do not call the endpoint difference a custom model-specific gain.

prospective_effect.end_to_end_gate: Bridge arms must preserve exact geometry, quality diagnostic, and SLO and must isolate one causal factor.

opportunities.falsifier: Bridge controls show the gain is generic runtime tuning or provider pricing rather than representation/model interaction.

next_measurement.workload_geometry: Exact campaign c1/c8 with same seeds and warmup.
next_measurement.quality_gate: Paired diagnostic plus carried absolute failure; no business quality claim.
next_measurement.service_gate: Exact geometry, success, TTFT, TPOT, cache state, and SLO.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: One-factor preregistration, repeated matched outcomes, cost, and teardown.

information_value.rating: medium-high for thesis attribution; lower immediate information per dollar
information_value.expected_resolution: Separates public representation/hardware economics from custom software differentiation.
information_value.information_per_dollar: medium-low relative to the no-weight microbenchmark

opportunities.claim_boundary: Current 81% derived endpoint cost reduction is a bundled campaign result, not a provider or custom co-design claim.

opportunities.title: MTP/speculative decoding architecture arm

observation.summary: MTP was repeatedly preregistered but never executed because quality, checkpoint delivery, or lineage gates stopped first.
observation.limitations: No acceptance rate, draft overhead, output identity, or SLO measurement exists.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: Model-native MTP may reduce decode iterations, but a 5% gain alone cannot close the business gap and may not preserve exact outputs.
competing_explanations: Low acceptance
verification overhead
quality mismatch
current workload dominated by prefill or non-draftable operations

candidate.intervention: Stock MTP off/on exact-identity diagnostic on the same complete checkpoint and retained H100.
candidate.stock_control: MTP disabled under otherwise identical SGLang settings.
changed_variables: MTP enablement and official draft shape

uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: No speculative-decoding result from another model may be transferred.

prospective_effect.component_gate: Exact normalized identity and measured draft acceptance/verification work.
prospective_effect.end_to_end_gate: >=5% c8 SLO-goodput with no quality or latency-tail regression.

opportunities.falsifier: Exact normalized identity fails, acceptance is too low, or c8 SLO-goodput improves by less than 5%.

next_measurement.workload_geometry: Exact fixed c1/c8 plus deterministic semantic fixtures.
next_measurement.service_gate: TTFT, TPOT, success, exact geometry, and SLO.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: Matched off/on results, acceptance counters, quality identity, cost, and teardown.

information_value.expected_resolution: Closes an architecture mechanism gap but is unlikely to establish provider competitiveness alone.

opportunities.claim_boundary: No MTP claim exists until a complete matched off/on result passes identity and SLO.

opportunities.title: Quality-screen recalibration and holdout expansion

observation.summary: Complete BF16 and AWQ both score 0.333 on the six-case development screen and fail its absolute gate; AWQ passes only paired non-regression and NLL diagnostics.
observation.limitations: One case per category, uncalibrated absolute NLL ceiling, formatting-sensitive exact scoring, and unused holdout.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: The current absolute gate mixes genuine capability failures with response-normalization and calibration defects.
competing_explanations: The model genuinely fails critical categories.
Reasoning policy or parser changes outputs.
The synthetic NLL sentence is out of distribution.

candidate.intervention: For a future campaign, calibrate a larger development suite on intended controls before freezing a disjoint holdout and normalization policy.
candidate.stock_control: Complete BF16 intended checkpoint plus an exact managed-provider control if available.
changed_variables: future quality suite only; do not alter the current frozen gate post hoc

uncertainty.quantified: Six binary cases cannot support a narrow non-inferiority conclusion.
uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: Do not promote the paired point pass to general quality parity.

prospective_effect.end_to_end_gate: A future candidate must pass the frozen expanded holdout and uncertainty policy.

opportunities.falsifier: A calibrated expanded suite confirms the same catastrophic categories and rejects AWQ or the base model.

next_measurement.workload_geometry: More exact/executable tool, code, retrieval, continuation, serving, and loss cases with disjoint splits.
next_measurement.quality_gate: Prospectively frozen category and paired uncertainty thresholds.
next_measurement.service_gate: Not applicable to offline calibration; serving correctness remains a separate gate.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: Content-addressed suite, provenance, calibration report, frozen policy, and hidden holdout identity.

information_value.rating: high for claim validity, low for immediate performance search
information_value.expected_resolution: Makes quality-adjusted economics possible or decisively rejects the model/representation.
information_value.information_per_dollar: high offline, but requires careful benchmark curation

opportunities.claim_boundary: The current frozen failure cannot be retroactively repaired or reinterpreted as a pass.

opportunities.title: Matched managed-provider control

observation.summary: No Fireworks or Baseten endpoint has run the campaign workload, quality suite, or SLO; current provider references are vendor claims or public prices only.
observation.limitations: Commercial API price is not provider COGS and may include caching, batching, or unavailable controls.

bottleneck_interpretation.hypothesis: A tuned managed provider may erase some or all of the apparent self-hosted endpoint advantage once workload, quality, availability, and service levels are matched.
competing_explanations: Provider lacks the exact model or deterministic controls.
API rate limits distort throughput.
Commercial pricing includes value beyond GPU cost.

candidate.intervention: Run the same content-addressed requests and quality cases against an exact-model managed endpoint with recorded API terms and price.
candidate.stock_control: Best campaign self-hosted point under the same request geometry and SLO.

sources: no credentials in prior campaign state
uncertainty.transfer_prohibited: Do not compare self-hosted GPU cost with public API price as if both were COGS.

prospective_effect.end_to_end_gate: Matched quality, TTFT, TPOT, success, availability, token geometry, and billed price.

opportunities.falsifier: The provider cannot expose the exact model/control surface or a matched run shows no self-hosted SLO-adjusted price advantage.

next_measurement.workload_geometry: Same fixed and agent workloads, arrival schedule, and token accounting as the self-hosted control.
next_measurement.quality_gate: Same frozen scorer and deterministic policy where provider controls permit it.
next_measurement.service_gate: TTFT, TPOT, success, rate-limit failures, queueing if observable, and availability.
next_measurement.artifact_contract: Sanitized request/response identities, endpoint/model revision, price terms, raw outcomes, quality, and cost arithmetic.

information_value.rating: high for business decision once executable
information_value.expected_resolution: Directly tests whether the campaign is competing with the relevant delivered service rather than an analytical anchor.
information_value.information_per_dollar: high if exact-model access and controls exist

opportunities.claim_boundary: Provider API price, self-hosted GPU cost, and provider COGS are distinct quantities.

selection_rule.method: Choose the highest-priority opportunity whose next measurement is executable, within budget, and capable of falsifying a material mechanism at the narrowest valid scope.
promotion_requirements: matched repeated full-server A/B before economic claim
quality and SLO gates before provider or business claim
prediction score and bottleneck-transition measurement after every promoted arm
